SELECT s.trade_id, s.title, s.price_point, s.thumb_img, s.recommend_cnt, s.regdate, m.nickname AS seller_nickname, t.toplct_name, c.item_ctg_name FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id JOIN top_location t ON s.toplct_id = t.toplct_id JOIN saletrade_item_category c ON s.item_ctg_id = c.item_ctg_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 'N'
AND s.item_ctg_id = #{itemCtgId}
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY s.trade_id DESC
SELECT s.*, m.nickname AS seller_nickname, m.email, m.profile_img FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id WHERE s.trade_id = #{tradeId} AND s.is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT trade_id, title, thumb_img, price_point FROM saletrade_board WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND trade_id != #{tradeId} AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY trade_id DESC LIMIT 4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_history ( trade_id, buyer_id, seller_id, used_point, earn_point, used_mileage ) VALUES ( #{trade_id}, #{buyer_id}, #{seller_id}, #{used_point}, #{earn_point}, #{used_mileage} )

INSERT INTO saletrade_board ( seller_id, title, content, price_point, max_mileage_use, quantity, thumb_img, item_ctg_id, toplct_id, detail_address, allow_full_mileage, status, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{seller_id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{price_point}, #{max_mileage_use}, #{quantity}, #{thumb_img}, #{item_ctg_id}, #{toplct_id}, #{detail_address}, #{allow_full_mileage}, 'S', 'N' )
